hard_blockers: mandatory arXiv API search expands the supplied corpus
ARXIV_ENDPOINT uses unauthenticated http rather than https
mandatory DeerFlow task subagents and subagent_enabled=true
metadata extraction is performed from abstracts rather than full papers
top-N relevance results are called a systematic literature review without eligibility screening or risk-of-bias assessment
search results are explicitly not persisted, weakening reproducibility
claim-level source locators and quoted evidence spans are absent
templates generate gaps and open questions outside the allowed outputs
hard-coded /mnt input and output paths are not portable
quality_risks: subagents may infer limitations described as obviously missing
failed extraction batches are silently omitted while synthesis continues
eval expectations measure workflow mechanics but not factual support or locator accuracy
arXiv-only preprint coverage cannot support the systematic label
